auth.heading: Sign in
auth.intro: Sign in with your DevAtlas account to continue.

error.slugLength: The slug must be 3 to 80 characters.
error.slugPattern: The slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
error.titleLength: The title must be 200 characters or fewer.
error.bodyLength: The body must be 200,000 characters or fewer.
error.sourceUrlLength: The source link must be 2,000 characters or fewer.
error.sourceUrlInsecure: The source link must be an absolute https:// address.
error.reasonTooShort: The reason must be at least 10 characters.
